svg.title: Direct steering, grid A*, and breadcrumb following
svg.desc: Picky moves toward a player beyond a wall. Direct steering stops at the wall. Grid search routes above it; breadcrumbs replay the player's route below it. The player is shown at the final destination.
svg.text: Three ways to follow the same player

g.text: Aim at the current player position.
Search the walkable cells for a route.

svg.text: Uses the corridor the player took
